reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles and I don't need another one. Plain magnesium bisglycinate is the same thing I keep seeing, and I'd wonder why it's only one form when other brands put several in one capsule.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? And I already have too many bottles I never finish.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing a problem I actually have, like waking up at 3am, plus a reason this one form works better than the multi-form ones, at the launch price.
